questions.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}A-(B-C) & =[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 7 & 1\end{aligned}]-([\begin{aligned}3 & 5 \\ 0 & -4\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 6 & 3\end{aligned}]) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 7 & 1\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}3-1 & 5-2 \\ 0-6 & -4-3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 7 & 1\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -6 & -7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4-2 & -2-3 \\ 7-(-6) & 1-(-7)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 13 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Sum or Difference of Three or More Matrices Using Distributivity
questions.worked_solution:
First, we simplify the expression by distributing the subtraction over the matrices in the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}G+H-(H+F) & =G+H-H-F \\  & =G+\cancel{H}-\cancel{H}-F \\  & =G-F\end{aligned}
$$

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}G-F & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 & -5 \\ 1 & -2 & 2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5-2 & 4-(-1) & -5-2 \\ 1-3 & -2-4 & 2-1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -7 \\ -2 & -6 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}(A+B)-C-(B-C) & =A+B-C-B+C \\  & =A+\cancel{B}-\cancel{C}-\cancel{B}+\cancel{C} \\  & =A\end{aligned}
$$

We are left with a single matrix. So, the result is 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}6 & 7 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}A+B-(C+B) & =A+B-C-B \\  & =A+\cancel{B}-C-\cancel{B} \\  & =A-C\end{aligned}
$$

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}A-C & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 7 & 0\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}8 & -2 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2-8 & -5-(-2) \\ 7-(-4) & 0-1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-6 & -3 \\ 11 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

$$
